steps: 1. Enable **Disable Enemy Spawns** before loading a full Adventure mission.
2. Play through the entire level and cross ordinary pacing areas.
3. Start a fresh run with the option off and confirm normal enemy pacing resumes.
4. Run `/gt_regression_test`, exit normally, and attach the newest log.
assertions: While enabled, no new ambient enemies, hordes, specials, patrols, monsters, bosses, or critters spawn. Existing units are not despawned. Disabling restores native spawning; queued entries may drain after a mid-mission disable, so the control uses a fresh run. Pickup and training-dummy spawns remain unaffected.
Harness: option on, load mission, tick 120 s through pacing; assert ConflictDirector._all_spawned_units stays empty and script_data flags set; option off: units appear.
